1.question: Is my Facebook Page safe?
1.answer: Bikrio uses the official Meta API and never asks for your Page password.

2.question: Does AI understand Banglish?
2.answer: Yes. AI is designed for Bangla, English, and Banglish conversations.

3.question: What happens after the free launch?
3.answer: Your data stays with you, and you can choose from the published plans when billing starts.

4.question: Which couriers are supported?
4.answer: Connections are designed for Steadfast, Pathao, and RedX.

5.question: Can my staff have limited access?
5.answer: Yes. Give teammates roles that match their work.

6.question: Can I cancel any time?
6.answer: Yes. CSV exports help you take your data with you.

7.question: Who can see my customer data?
7.answer: Only approved members of your shop. Network checks share counts only.

8.question: Do I need a computer?
8.answer: No. Bikrio works on phones, tablets, and computers.

legal.reviewNote: A qualified Bangladeshi legal professional must review these pages before launch.

account.title: Account information
account.body: Your name, email, and phone are used for login, support, and billing. They are kept until you request account deletion.

shopData.title: Shop and customer data
shopData.body: Products, orders, ledger entries, customer names, phones, addresses, and messages are processed for your business and kept while the shop exists.

network.title: Anonymous network counts
network.body: For fraud prevention, anonymous total, received, and returned counts linked to a phone number may be shared between shops. Names, addresses, and shop identities are never shared.

analytics.title: Website analytics
analytics.body: We may keep masked IP, device, path, and time to understand website usage.

ai.title: AI processing
ai.body: When you choose to use it, AI processes customer messages and your business information. We send no more data than needed for the task.

facebook.title: Facebook data
facebook.body: Facebook Page and Messenger data are used for the inbox and order workflows you request. Disconnecting a Page removes its token.

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.body: Contact support to request shop or customer deletion. A Meta data-deletion callback removes the relevant data.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for protecting your login and choosing which approved members can access your shop.

shopData.title: Your shop data

network.title: Network protection
network.body: Customer checks may share anonymous order-outcome counts for fraud prevention; people and shops are not identified.

analytics.title: Visitor analytics
analytics.body: Bikrio may use visitor analytics with masked IPs to improve the site.

ai.title: AI use
ai.body: You are responsible for reviewing AI replies. AI is not a source of invented prices, stock, or policies.

facebook.title: Facebook data
